environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Basic tier B1) behind Azure Application Gateway with no WAF policy attached. The API is publicly accessible on port 443. No input validation middleware. System.Linq.Dynamic.Core v1.3.5 installed with default configuration allowing all expression types including method invocations and property access. No network segmentation between app tier and data stores.

config.network: flat VNet, no NSG restrictions on outbound
